notes.title: 0.4.1 __ GUN SKILL UPD
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709805/556cf2d7469004696c7ad828f2609b3825ccaf37.png[/img]

- Guns Level new upgradable parameter: improves damage and reload time of non-magical weapons
- autoGun
- golden auto crossbow
- ICE and FIRE staffs have alt attack mode
- ELECTIRC staff alt-attack (BFG like projectile)
- shotGun alt shot (double shot)
- Auto Crossbow uses regular arrows now
- fixed pipe gun fatal error
- fast weapon select (Q, 1, 2, 3) will choses the most valuable weapon first and only weapon which has ammo
- hold 1-2-3 to replace active weapon to the best one from the inventory

- LAST CHANCE BOOTS faster move when less health
- slime hat (can't be slowed down)
- ninja shoes (all ninja items make more shuriken damage)
- vampyr hat restores 1 hp after every kill
- manna hat restores 1 manna after every kill
- mechanic hat: +10 guns level
- barbarian helmet: -10 guns level // +50 damage resistance
- barbarian boots: -10 guns level // +10 damage resistance // + 5 kick level

- NPC jump of places which they can't walk off
- kicked damage applies on NPC landing after kicked (so you can kick even the dying enemies)
- NPCs killed with fire (and explosion) would not be able to respawn
- item spawn cheat menu with items to choose (not only to type)
- blue flower heals 1 manna
- potion/craft recipes book (hidden)
- used items minus UI animation

- falling leaves FX and piles
- cemetery castle level
- burnable web
- rat holes (can be destroyed)
- rats jump now
- heart beat sound when low on health
